fusions.name: Shoal Wheel
fusions.desc: You wheel through the spray you kick up, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flung Spray
fusions.desc: Flicks river water off your heels at the first enemy in line, dealing 4 damage with a 25% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Flanks
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises 20% for 12 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Wriggle Free
fusions.desc: When you take damage other than fire, you regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You also gain +6% dodge chance.
